name: SWE-bump-bench
description: A Swedish-language benchmark designed to probe model performance on a set of curated tasks (likely involving classification or understanding) in Swedish. It measures how well models handle language-specific phenomena, domain knowledge, and task instructions in Swedish. Useful for evaluating multilingual and Swedish-focused models across standard NLP metrics.
reputation: A small, community-contributed Swedish benchmark with limited but growing use for evaluating Swedish-language capabilities.
